title: Multi-omics characterization of early chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
summary: Integrated multi-omics analysis in clinically confirmed early COPD cases and controls identifies molecular differences and candidate pathways associated with early disease. The study combines clinical CPHS cohort data with models; supports disease-specific multi-omics characterization, limited to the discovery cohort and exploratory interpretation.
